title-group.article-title: Projections of the basolateral amyg­dala to the central nucleus in the mouse

abstract.p: We injected an anterograde tracer into the basolateral amygdala (BLA) of adult mice and mapped labelled axons. Dense terminal fields were found in the medial central nucleus (CeM), and sparse fibres in the lateral central nucleus (CeL).

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Animals were anaesthetised with isoflurane (1.5–2 %) and placed in a stereotaxic frame. Please note that all procedures followed the national guidelines for the care and use of laboratory animals. AAV‑hSyn‑EGFP (50 nl) was injected unilaterally into the BLA at 0.1 μl/min, and brains were collected three weeks later.
Labelled fibres were counted in n = 6 sections per animal; density was computed as d=n⁢A−1, where A is the area of each nucleus.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Every injection labelled axons in the CeM, with fewer in the CeL​/​capsular part. To check specificity, readers can compare the injection sites in Figure 1 with the terminal fields in Table 1.
No labelled terminals were found in the medial amygdala in any animal.

ack.p: We thank the imaging facility for help with confocal microscopy.
